topic: Data migration for JCD Brazil stage to prod
summary_markdown: Someone requested the transfer of data for JCD Brazil from a staging environment to production. The scope was defined as starting from February 20th up to the current date. [me] confirmed that this action would be completed within half an hour and subsequently reported that it had been done.
decisions: JCD Brazil data migrated from stage to prod, covering the period from Feb 20th to present.
